ROCM's situation is a little different with CUDA. on CUDA supporting Flash attention implies supporting memory efficient attention, but on ROCM we decided to support Flash attention first and leave memory efficient attention later. 

This is also why we created `get_platform_specific_sdpa()` function earlier. Specific to this case we cannot test Memory efficient attention on ROCM for now because it only triggers errors.

I'll check and fix the coverage of tests on CUDA platform in a later patch.

body:
Although the benefits of `get_platform_specific_sdpa` are not very clear, which is due to we are focusing to get the infrastructure PR merged ASAP without enabling all tests, but in some cases we do.

The current UT has an assumption: "If a platform supports Flash Attention, it must support Memory efficient attention as well". However this is not true for ROCM (and potentially other platforms). 
`get_platform_specific_sdpa` is introduced to address this problem in a single place, and it will replace more `@parametrize("kernel")` when we are enabling more tests.

Additionally there is another benefit. If a new type of attention backend were added, only this function needs updates.
